roleLabel: Long-range Assassin sniper — Killshot the farthest enemy with Crit-stacked arrows
bestFor: Backline boards that want safe execute pressure and Mana Regen / distance scaling
strength: Always threatens the back of the enemy formation; Crit on Killshot and distance bonuses reward correct placement
weakness: Dies instantly to dive if unprotected; low value if the farthest target is the wrong kill

howToPlay.early: Draft with a real front line. Hoyoung is a carry, not an opener. Crit and Attack matter more than standing him naked.
howToPlay.mid: Conduit = kill → permanent Mana Regen shared to Assassins/Mystics. Hunter = early-cast Crit stacks + Shards per hex distance on kill. Sniper = always farthest target and autos scale with hex distance. Pick team cast economy, distance economy, or pure sniper identity.
howToPlay.late: Keep him alive and far. Assassin Patience/Ambush pieces and Crit relics unlock Killshot spikes.
howToPlay.positioning: True back corner opposite dive. Maximize hex distance to the priority target when on Hunter/Sniper.

abilityNotes.Killshot: Farthest-enemy nuke with huge Crit scaling. Placement chooses the target — wrong corner = wrong kill.

specNotes.The Conduit: Team Mana Regen on kills for Assassin/Mystic boards. Take when you run cast-heavy friends.
specNotes.The Hunter: Take when you can secure distance kills for Shard payouts and early Crit on Killshot.
specNotes.The Sniper: Hard commit to farthest-target autos. Take when geometry consistently puts the carry target far away.

relicReasons.assassins-patience-banner-551: Patience/sniper fantasy for long-range Assassin play.
relicReasons.assassins-ambush-engine-4003: Execute engine that pays when Killshot connects.
relicReasons.assassins-elevation-prism-3006: Assassin power prism for Crit/carry spikes.

faq.question: Is Hoyoung good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent protected sniper. Useless if dive deletes him first. Buy with a tank plan, not as your first board piece.

faq.question: What class is Hoyoung?
faq.answer: Assassin. Role focus: long-range farthest-target executioner.

faq.question: What relics work with Hoyoung?
faq.answer: Assassin Patience/Ambush/Elevation pieces and Crit tools.

faq.question: How do you play Hoyoung?
faq.answer: Park him far back, stack Crit, cast Killshot on the farthest priority target, and pick Conduit, Hunter, or Sniper based on team vs distance fantasy.

tips: After losses, ask which enemy was farthest — if it was a tank, rotate his corner.
Conduit wants Assassin/Mystic friends; solo Hoyoung usually prefers Hunter/Sniper.
